title: pm-dispatch(triage): the triage seat may close a duplicate card and a completed tracking parent (maintainer ruling 2026-11-05)
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: carrying a maintainer ruling into the skill. ⛔ Not a claim. The maintainer ruled in the triage session on 2026-11-05: 「同意，需要的话立skills卡」. That answered triage's question, "may triage close duplicate cards and completed tracking parents itself?"

## What the skill says today

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md`: 「只写标签与审计评论,⛔ 无 PR、无认领」. Closing is not among triage's writes. So a duplicate a lane names, or a tracking parent whose children are all closed, waits for the maintainer's hand: #30118, #26059, #30373 and #30374 waited one to ten days. Lanes do not self-close either: `domain:ui#4` asked triage to close #30118 (6649804194).

## Wanted

Add the ruled power to the triage charter, and to `triage-duties.md` where the duties list it, with its limits:

- Triage may close a card as `duplicate` when the target card is named and the overlap is read fresh. It may close a tracking parent as `completed` when every child carrying `Part of #n` is closed and the parent itself holds no open work.
- Each close is preceded by a signed comment that names the ruling and the evidence: the duplicate's target, or the list of closed children.
- ⛔ Not covered: closing on merits ("won't do", "not a bug"), closing a card a seat holds a live claim on, or closing a security card. These stay with the maintainer, on the human floor.

Reader: `domain:skills` (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`). This is internal agent tooling, not the published `skills/` catalogue, so no `@objectstack/skills` changeset. The lane is offline now; the card waits for it.

Refs: #6015
